audit_scope: Independent post-repair audit of the frozen M1 data, near-dedup repair, splits, leakage, tokenizer, token counts, 50M sequence, portability, tests, handoff, and DoD.

category_scores.evidence: One repaired corpus, split, tokenizer, and fixed order are shared by every PE condition; translated-enwiki remains excluded.
Twenty original and fourteen local-core shard checks pass; access date and dataset license are recorded, while unavailable per-source revisions/licenses remain explicit.
Conservative NFC and whitespace/control handling preserve Azerbaijani text; the frozen 50-letter rule has a documented Books II distribution effect.
SHA-256 exact groups, deterministic representatives, provenance, and 144,480 removals reconcile.
Complete observed-bucket expansion produced 6,444,499 candidates; sample and all-59-bucket audits measured 100% eligible-pair recall before exact verification.
All raw, short, exact, near, retained, and split identities reconcile exactly.
Cluster-aware seed-2026 manifests are deterministic, hash-frozen, and sum to 6,193,931 retained documents.
Internal ID/hash/graph gates, all large buckets, and the former-237 regression pass with zero known retained true-near cross-split pairs.
All candidates share the same hash-frozen one-million-document repaired-train-only corpus.
8K/16K/32K metrics use the same audit sample and explicit token denominators; Azerbaijani round trips and coverage checks pass.
The final 16K BPE reloads with verified artifact hashes and fixed <unk>/<eod> IDs.
All 6,193,931 rows reconcile to 605,720,737 final-16K tokens with one EOD per document.
Independent replay matched 277,027 unique train IDs, order, source totals, subset hash, and exact inside-document boundary.
Seeds, versions, config hashes, checkpoints, artifact hashes, relative operational paths, and relocation simulation are recorded.
The faulty star path was replaced by complete deterministic enumeration with config-bound stage state, bounded transactions, and guarded promotion.
Core modules are focused and naturally documented; a few legacy parameter names and long finalization scripts remain.
Streaming Parquet, batched SQLite, durable checkpoints, and bounded enumeration are practical; full validation remains intentionally I/O-heavy.
Thirty tests pass, including the original large-bucket failure, resume, leakage, relocation, boundary, and frozen-artifact regression cases.
The full validator checked every selected processed-row reference and reconciled final hashes, counts, tokenizer, subset, and prerequisites.
Measured notes, data card, four figures, repair disclosure, limitations, hashes, and the exact boundary are report-ready.

findings.description: Connected-component closure is intentionally transitive; sampled arbitrary endpoints reached Jaccard 0.8199 although every accepted graph edge is at least 0.95.
findings.engineering_impact: None for M2/M3 consumption; semantics must remain visible in methods and limitations.
findings.evidence: near_repair_validation.json sampled the 25 largest clusters; 24 contained an endpoint pair below 0.95.
findings.exact_recommended_fix: Keep the frozen policy and report edge-versus-component semantics and the sampled range in the final paper.
findings.scientific_impact: The policy is leakage-protective but can remove a document not directly near the chosen representative.

findings.description: Per-source licenses and revisions are unavailable in local upstream metadata; Books I/II labels are size-based inferences.
findings.evidence: source_registry.yaml records null source-level values and explains the inference; dataset-level CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 is locally documented.
findings.exact_recommended_fix: Retain explicit unknown values and seek authoritative upstream component metadata before publication if available.
findings.scientific_impact: No measured data-integrity effect, but provenance claims must remain qualified.

findings.description: The 50-Unicode-letter threshold removes most short records from mediocore-books and changes document-level source balance.
findings.evidence: 1,873,780 of 1,873,990 short removals come from mediocore-books; retained character and token totals are reported separately.
findings.exact_recommended_fix: Report the source-specific removal table and avoid post-hoc threshold changes after experiments begin.
findings.scientific_impact: This is a frozen pre-model choice and a limitation when interpreting book-domain coverage.

findings.description: Historical raw inventory and audit evidence retain original absolute access/display paths.
findings.engineering_impact: After relocation, raw revalidation needs the default relative clone location or AZ_PE_DOLLMA_ROOT.
findings.evidence: Operational manifests and handoff paths are repository-relative; simulated relocation passes. External DOLLMA resolution is separate.
findings.exact_recommended_fix: Set AZ_PE_DOLLMA_ROOT if the external clone is not adjacent to the moved repository.
findings.scientific_impact: None; original access locations are provenance, not operational dependencies.

findings.description: The complete candidate function retains a max_star_bucket compatibility parameter name although no star expansion is reachable.
findings.evidence: near.py reports strategy complete_bucket_pairs, star=0, skipped=0; regression tests verify non-anchor completeness.
findings.exact_recommended_fix: Rename in a later cleanup only if backward compatibility can be preserved without touching frozen behavior.

accounting.reconciliation: raw = empty + short + exact removals + exact unique; retained = exact unique - near removals

near_dedup.connected_component_semantics: Every accepted edge has direct character-5-gram Jaccard >= 0.95. Clusters are connected components and are not necessarily pairwise >= 0.95.

score_normalization.method: The historical weights sum to 105; weighted score is sum(weight * category score) / 105.
